name: Unstable Furniture Archway

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-13: All That Glitters

disable: DC 21 Athletics check to knock the pile over in a safe direction or DC 19 Thievery check (trained) to carefully rearrange the furniture to a stable configuration.
routine: On its initiative, the pile expands into an adjacent space, dealing creatures in that space 1d6+4 bludgeoning damage with a DC 18 basic Reflex save save, pushing any creatures in that space into an adjacent empty space, and making that space impassable until cleared. If no adjacent empty space is available, the pile buries the creature, suffocating it. Clearing a space or pulling a creature out requires a DC 15 Athletics check check.

items.name: Tumbling Down
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves into a space adjacent to the furniture pile

---
Effect Part of the pile slides into a space the creature occupies, causing 1d6+4 bludgeoning damage with a DC 18 basic Reflex save save. The furniture pile rolls initiative.

text: This unsteady pile of furniture is piled to the top of this usually high-ceilinged room. There looks to be some space to squeeze through to the other side, but even the slightest touch causes the stack to destabilize, and there's so much that once it begins to fall, it's difficult to stop.
